add_tensormask_config: add TensorMask configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode for model setup
review_add_tensormask_config: review the add_tensormask_config function to verify default anchor and loss parameters
customize_tensormask_num_classes: customize the TensorMask NUM_CLASSES config value for a dataset with fewer than 80 classes
adjust_tensormask_focal_loss: adjust the TensorMask focal loss gamma and alpha hyperparameters for better training
enable_tensormask_bipyramid: enable the bipyramid architecture by setting BIPYRAMID_ON to True in the config
